reviews.title: Only for Japanese version app
reviews.body: The battlepass is only for the Japanese version app, if your zone is Hong Kong, Taiwan or Singapore , the QR code is not going to work. You have to create another account for the Japanese zone and use a translator to navigate and attach to the Bluetooth of your phone. Same with the beyblade X ( if you buy the Japanese version can not scan the QR codes for the English version in Singapore. At the end I have 2 accounts. Singapore and Japan.
reviews.author: Syrtis Major

reviews.title: Great product even better seller
reviews.body: Works amazing the seller is easy to contact and helped me with issues I was having. Just keep in mind you need to be able to access the japan app store to get the right berblade x app for it to work. As of now there is no way to see your launch speed as you launch besides playing a mini game in the app. I was hoping it would work like it does in the show and you could launch 5 times in a row and just get readings instead of having to replay the mini game each time.
